Welcome to Damn Vulnerable Web Application!

Damn Vulnerable Web Application (DVWA) ek PHP/MySQL web application hai jo damn vulnerable hai. Iska main goal hai ki security professionals apne skills aur tools ko legal environment mein test kar sakein, web developers ko web applications secure karne ke processes ko behtar tarike se samajhne mein madad mile aur students & teachers dono controlled classroom environment mein web application security ke baare mein seekh sakein.
DVWA ka aim kuch sabse common web vulnerabilities ko, alag-alag difficulty levels ke saath, ek simple straightforward interface ke sath practice karna hai.

Yeh user par depend karta hai ki woh DVWA ko kaise approach karte hain. Ya toh har module ko ek fixed level par complete karke, ya koi bhi module select karke aur highest level tak pahunch kar. Module complete karne ka koi fixed objective nahi hai; par users ko lagna chahiye ki unhone us particular vulnerability ka use karke system ko best possible tarike se exploit kar liya hai.
Please note, is software mein documented aur undocumented dono vulnerabilities hain. Yeh intentional hai. Aapko encourage kiya jata hai ki aap zyada se zyada issues discover karein.
Every module mein View Source (current level ka real DVWA PHP), Compare All aur View Help buttons hote hain.

Sab kuch native Android UI hai aur app ke andar offline chalta hai: koi WebView nahi, koi embedded web server nahi, koi INTERNET permission nahi. Ek bundled SQLite database, ek simulated Debian file system/shell aur ek PHP-behaviour port Kotlin mein LAMP stack ki jagah lete hain. Sabhi vulnerabilities sirf is app ke apne sandboxed data ko touch karti hain.
Damn Vulnerable Web Application is damn vulnerable! Sirf unhi systems par practice karein jinke aap owner hain ya test karne ke liye authorized hain.

1. Setup / Reset DB 5 users aur guestbook ko restore karta hai (yeh first launch par bhi create hota hai).
2. admin / password se log in karein. Dusre accounts: gordonb / abc123, 1337 / charley, pablo / letmein, smithy / password.
3. DVWA Security mein ek level chunein (Low, Medium, High, Impossible).
4. Menu se ek module choose karein. Har screen par View Source aur View Help use karein.
How web concepts map to this app

• Hidden form fields, headers (Referer, User-Agent), cookies aur client-side limits (maxlength, dropdowns) har module ke orange \"Intercept & tamper\" panel mein editable hain — Burp Suite / DevTools ka native equivalent.\n• Toolbar menu mein ek simulated address bar (Go to URL…) hai pages ko directly request karne ke liye, jaise /vulnerabilities/authbypass/.\n• Blind/time-based attacks ke liye request timing dikhayi jati hai.

• Database: real bundled SQLite. Vulnerable levels string concatenation se SQL banate hain; Impossible prepared statements use karta hai. MySQL-isms translate kiye gaye hain: # comments, user(), database(), version()/@@version, concat(), substring()/mid(), ascii(), sleep(n) aur ek information_schema.tables/columns/schemata emulation. sqlite_master bhi kaam karta hai.\n

• Command Injection: ek fake shell interpreter (; && || | & $( ) aur backticks; ping, id, whoami, uname, ls, cat, head, tail, grep, wc, find, ps, env, echo …) ek fake Debian file system ke upar. Koi real device command kabhi run nahi hota.\n

• XSS (DOM/Reflected/Stored), CSP Bypass aur JavaScript Attacks: yahan koi browser nahi hai. Vulnerable PHP jo HTML banata, uska natively analysis hota hai; jab browser kisi script ko execute karta, toh aapko “⚠ XSS fired” aur ek simulated alert dialog milta hai. Safe levels mein escaped output dikhta hai.\n
• File Upload / File Inclusion app ke private storage ko use karte hain; uploaded .php files ek chhote webshell simulator se pass hote hain.\n
• Insecure CAPTCHA, Google reCAPTCHA ki jagah local text CAPTCHA use karta hai.\n
• Device se kabhi kuch bahar nahi jata; external redirects/requests ko display kiya jata hai, perform nahi.
Damn Vulnerable Web Application (DVWA) ek PHP/MySQL web application hai jo damn vulnerable hai.

Yeh app (v2.1.0) personal practice ke liye DVWA ke modules ka ek offline, fully native Android (Kotlin) re-implementation hai. Original DVWA Ryan Dewhurst (ethicalhack3r), Robin Wood (digininja) aur contributors dwara hai, jo GNU General Public License v3 ke andar released hai; iske help texts, images aur PHP sources (View Source ke through dikhaye gaye) usi license ke andar bundled hain.

DVWA free software hai: aap ise Free Software Foundation dwara published GNU General Public License ke terms ke andar redistribute aur/ya modify kar sakte hain, ya toh License ke version 3 ke andar, ya (aapke option par) kisi bhi baad ke version ke andar.
Simulated server ka phpinfo() (static, reconnaissance practice ke liye):
Aap security level ko low, medium, high ya impossible par set kar sakte hain. Security level DVWA ke vulnerability level ko badal deta hai:\n\n

1. Low - Yeh security level poori tarah se vulnerable hai aur isme koi security measures nahi hain. Iska use is baat ka example dena hai ki kharab coding practices ke through web application vulnerabilities kaise aati hain aur basic exploitation techniques sikhane ya sikhne ke liye platform provide karna hai.\n

2. Medium - Yeh setting mainly user ko kharab security practices ka example dene ke liye hai, jahan developer ne application ko secure karne ki koshish ki par fail ho gaya. Yeh users ke liye apni exploitation techniques ko refine karne ki challenge ke roop mein bhi kaam karta hai.\n

3. High - Yeh option medium difficulty ka ek extension hai, jisme code ko secure karne ke koshish mein hard ya alternative bad practices ka mixture hai. Vulnerability utni had tak exploitation allow nahi kar sakti, jaise alag-alag Capture The Flags (CTFs) competitions mein hota hai.\n
4. Impossible - Yeh level sabhi vulnerabilities ke khilaf secure hona chahiye. Iska use vulnerable source code ko secure source code ke sath compare karne ke liye hota hai.
Security level %1$s set kar diya gaya
Apna database banane ya reset karne ke liye niche diye gaye \'Create / Reset Database\' button par click karein. Agar koi error aaye toh ensure karein ki aapke paas sahi user credentials hain.
